title: Data for: Molecular SKALA in CP2K: Machine-Learned Exchange-Correlation through a GauXC Atomic-Orbital Interface
description: CP2K input files, selected raw CP2K outputs, BEGDB water-hexamer benchmark tables, CPU/GPU timing diagnostics, extraction scripts, regression-test inputs, and Supplementary Information files supporting the molecular GPW/GAPW GauXC/SKALA validation study.
